intended_object: The canonical homeomorphism X × {*} ≅ X, the projection onto the first factor, with the one-point space carrying its unique topology. This comes from the docstring.
explanation: The definition takes the underlying bijection to be `Equiv.prodPUnit X`, which sends (x, *) to x. It leaves the two continuity fields to the automatic tactic. Both maps are continuous: one is the first projection, the other is x ↦ (x, *). So the definition gives exactly the canonical homeomorphism, and it works for any topological space X. Mathlib also has `Homeomorph.prodUnique`, which does the same for any `Unique` second factor. `prodPUnit` is the standard special case for the specific one-point type `PUnit`, which is a particular object, so it is not too narrow.
